say:0:1821416001:1.text: A dark bloodstain marks the wall where Bentley vanished. Below it lies a badly decayed body with a dagger buried in its chest. It's Bentley, the ship's doctor.
say:0:1821416001:1.source_cn: 在班特里消失的墙边，留有一道清晰的血痕。此外，一具胸前...

say:1:1821416002:1.text: Even in death, his bony fingers remain clenched around something.
say:1:1821416002:1.source_cn: 他的指骨紧攥，死亡也未能让他松动手中的物品。

say:2:1821416003:1.text: The bones have grown brittle with age and snap as you pry his hand open. A finely made <style="highlight">ring</style> and a <style="highlight">key</style> fall from his grasp.
say:2:1821416003:1.source_cn: 因其死亡已久，你稍一用力指骨便发出断裂的脆响，一枚做工...
say:2:1821416003:1.male: The bones have grown brittle with age and snap as you pry his hand open. A finely made <style="highlight">ring</style> and a <style="highlight">key</style> fall from his grasp.
say:2:1821416003:1.female: The bones have grown brittle with age and snap as you pry his hand open. A finely made <style="highlight">ring</style> and a <style="highlight">key</style> fall from his grasp.

say:3:1821416004:1.text: Bentley wasn't wearing the ring. He had been clutching it. Perhaps he tore it from someone while fighting over the key—which would mean <style="highlight">the ring belonged to his killer</style>...
say:3:1821416004:1.source_cn: 那枚戒指不像是戴在班特里手上，更像是被他紧紧攥在手里。...
